title: Dynamic Service Generation
short_description: Evaluation of LLMs' capability to generate dynamic IoT services
long_description: An empirical study exploring the effectiveness of Large Language Models in generating IoT services dynamically at runtime. The study evaluates different models using CodeBERTScore metrics and analyzes their token efficiency.
